name: Prompt do diretor de cenas
summary: Guia de estilo do Diretor de cenas: captura primeiro, só refs oferecidas, movimentos e transições da lista do modelo.

variables.name: scriptSceneIds
variables.description: sceneId of each DirectorPacket.inputs.script.scenes entry; one visual per scene, same order.

variables.name: captureIds
variables.description: captureId of each DirectorPacket.inputs.capturesIndex entry; empty when nothing was captured.

variables.name: offeredRefs
variables.description: ref (assetId@version) of each DirectorPacket.inputs.offeredRefs entry; the only refs to cite besides own search results.

variables.name: cameraMoves
variables.description: DirectorPacket.constraints.cameraMoves, from the bound template's details.cameraMoves.

variables.name: transitions
variables.description: DirectorPacket.constraints.transitions, from the bound template's details.transitions.

variables.name: retryInstruction
variables.description: DirectorPacket.inputs.retryInstruction: the Reviewer's instruction, on a revision only.

notes: Bound to slot prompt:director. Topology v1 DirectorPacket has no prompt field, so in R1 the engine records this version for prompt-version metering only (topology section 10); the role's built-in prompt director@1 drives the call. Output contract: ScenesOutput (C7).
